meta.title: Token Panorama
meta.description: Reads every stored session log into a token panorama: lifetime totals, cache hit rate and unit cost, peak/off-peak billing, calendar heatmap, trend and efficiency charts, budget alerts, session/workspace/model breakdown, tool self-consumption ledger, runtime metrics, CSV/JSON/Markdown export and periodic reports, plus context clear/compact, prompt optimization, auto answers, and English/Chinese/Japanese locales.
